runSpecDescription: VEIN portable start and evaporative factor reference. MOVES6.0.0, Washtenaw County MI defaults, calendar 2025, all 13 onroad vehicle types and valid fuels, January weekday. Start exhaust CO/NOx and evaporative THC (permeation, vapor venting, leaks). Temperatures are artificial lookup grid points: hour 1=20 C, 2=10 C, 3=30 C, RH=50%. U.S. reference, not an Ecuador calibration.
